ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) speckling concentrated along the lower transverse axis near the water line.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity regions occupy the upper 70% of both lobes; high-intensity pixel clusters (speckling) are scattered across the lower quadrants with a higher density on the right lobe medial-ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees; vertex is sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the majority of the trailing edge; the distal tip of the right lobe exhibits high-amplitude, irregular jaggedness compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe presents a slightly concave upward sweep; right lobe presents a more pronounced convex upward trajectory toward the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive field of small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (micro-dots) distributed across the lower 40% of the visible fluke surface, likely representing barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, high-intensity white curvilinear marking (crescent-shaped) is located on the upper-central region of the right lobe; several faint vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique, high-contrast white crescent-shaped scar (approximate coordinates upper-right quadrant) serves as a primary distinctive marker.
